name: Carousel
description: Scroll-snapped slides with previous and next buttons and position dots, on the carousel machine ImageSlider uses (D-041). perView shows several at once with the next one peeking. A title puts the buttons in a header; without one they overlay the slides.

livewire.name: carousel
capabilities: wire:model binds the slide shown (index) through $wire.entangle()
@scope('slide', $slide) renders each slide's content, with $loop->index as its index; 2.x slides keep their image, alt, title and description keys

react.name: Carousel
capabilities: renderSlide(slide, index) renders each slide's content

vue.name: Carousel
capabilities: The #slide="{ slide, index }" slot renders each slide's content

props.name: slides
props.description: The slides, in order. By default each is a Card from { image, alt, title, description }; the slide render content draws anything else. When every slide has a distinct id it keys the slide, so a reordered list keeps each slide's own state; else slides are keyed by position.

props.name: perView
props.description: Slides in view at once, a whole number. Above 1 the next slide peeks at the inline end, and each move shows one more slide. Emitted as --slides-per-page.

props.name: index
props.description: The position shown, 0-based: the slide at the start of the view. Livewire binds it with wire:model. Pair it with index-change to control it.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: The initial position of an uncontrolled carousel.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wraps from the last position to the first and back.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Advances every interval ms, with a visible pause button. It pauses while the pointer or focus is on the carousel, and starts paused under reduced motion.
props.a11y: Autoplay always has a visible pause button (2.2.2) and never starts on its own under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds between slides while autoplay runs.

props.name: title
props.description: A heading in the header, with the previous and next buttons beside it. It names the region unless label is set. Without it the buttons overlay the slides.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the region. Defaults to a passed aria-label, then the title, else "Carousel". Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Carousel' ).
props.a11y: A page with several carousels names each one.

props.name: previousLabel
props.a11y: The button is icon-only, so this is its only name.

props.name: nextLabel
props.a11y: The button is icon-only, so this is its only name.

props.name: indicatorLabel
props.description: A dot's accessible name. {index} is replaced; Livewire's __() string uses :index.

props.name: slideLabel
props.description: A slide's accessible name. Livewire's __() string uses :index and :count.

props.name: playLabel
props.description: The autoplay button's name while paused.

props.name: pauseLabel
props.description: The autoplay button's name while playing.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { viewport: '…', item: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The carousel's region: role region with aria-roledescription carousel, named by label or the title.

parts.name: header
parts.description: With a title: the heading, then the previous and next buttons at the inline end.

parts.name: viewport
parts.description: Clips the track; the overlay buttons sit on it when there's no header.

parts.name: itemGroup
parts.description: The scroll-snapping track. The spec calls it track; it keeps Zag's name (D-019).

parts.name: item
parts.description: A slide: role group with aria-roledescription slide, named "2 of 6"; slides out of view are aria-hidden. The spec calls it slide.

parts.name: prevTrigger
parts.description: Shows the previous position: an outline icon-only Button in the header, or a soft one over the viewport's start edge. The spec's nav (prev).

parts.name: nextTrigger
parts.description: Shows the next position. The spec's nav (next).

parts.name: indicatorGroup
parts.description: The row of dots under the viewport, one per position. The spec calls it dots.

parts.name: indicator
parts.description: A dot that shows its position; aria-current and a wider primary pill mark the one shown.

parts.name: autoplayTrigger
parts.description: Pauses and resumes autoplay, with autoplay. Always visible while autoplay is on. The root's first child, so it comes first in the Tab order; it sits over the viewport's top start.

slots.name: slide
slots.description: Scoped render content for one slide's content, given the slide and its index: @scope('slide', $slide) in Blade ($loop->index is the index), #slide="{ slide, index }" in Vue, renderSlide in React.

events.name: index-change
events.description: The carousel moved to another position: a button, a dot, a swipe or autoplay. Setting index doesn't fire it.

keyboard.action: Move between the previous and next buttons, the track, the dots and the autoplay button.
On a button or dot: shows its position, or pauses and resumes autoplay.
On the dots: show the next or previous position. They follow the text direction, so in RTL ArrowLeft shows the next one.
On the dots: show the first or last position.

requirements: The root is a region with aria-roledescription carousel and a translatable name (label, else the title).
Each slide is a group with aria-roledescription slide, named "n of N"; slides out of view are hidden from assistive technology.
The track is a polite live region, off while autoplay runs, so moves are announced.
The previous and next buttons and the dots have accessible names (translatable); the dot shown carries aria-current.

Autoplay never runs without a visible pause button, first in the carousel's Tab order (before the rotating slides), pauses while the pointer or focus is on the carousel, and starts paused under prefers-reduced-motion (2.2.2).
Arrow keys follow the text direction; the previous and next icons mirror and the next slide peeks at the inline end in RTL.
Every part keeps a stable, server-rendered id in Livewire (D-015).
